svg.title: Heedline (NavSentinel): checking consequential browser actions (animated)
svg.desc: Illustrative loop of the local MV3 interaction guard: an ordinary link is admitted, a hidden overlay that retargets a click is blocked and suppressed with Undo, a popunder window.open is blocked, a fake-CAPTCHA clipboard command gets a ClickFix warning, and a password post to a lookalike domain gets an in-page guard prompt. Selected events are retained in the bounded local Protection Center journal; these example rows are not a complete browsing history or a live protection receipt. No network lookup.
svg.text: local MV3 extension · illustrative decisions · Smart mode · pre-alpha, not efficacy-validated

g.text: To verify: press Win+R, paste, Enter

svg.text: the Gym replays attack and benign contrasts as evidence
An ordinary link: checked locally and admitted
A hidden overlay retargets the click: blocked, the layer is removed, Undo is one tap
A popunder window.open is intercepted in the main world and blocked
ClickFix: a fake CAPTCHA puts a command on the clipboard, so Heedline warns
A password post to a lookalike domain: the prompt is an in-page guard (closed shadow root)
